model.name: Model for the renal excretion of empagliflozin and EG and the urinary glucose excretion.

notes.body:
Model for the renal excretion of empagliflozin and its glucuronide (EG), the renal glucuronidation of empagliflozin and the urinary glucose excretion.
16-23 % of an oral dose of empagliflozin is excreted unchanged in the urine with a renal clearance of 28-39 ml/min [Seman2013, Sarashina2013, Macha2014, Macha2014f]; the glucuronides in the urine are 23 % of the dose [Chen2015a].
The renal excretion is relative to the glomerular filtration rate (GFR): the filtration of the unbound fraction (fu 0.14) and a tubular secretion by OAT3 (f_oat3); probenecid lowers the renal clearance from 32.7 to 15.2 ml/min, the filtration [Macha2014].
The kidney glucuronidates empagliflozin (UGT1A9, UGT2B7) after its uptake by OAT3; the renal glucuronidation scales with the renal function (the functional renal mass), which makes the exposure of empagliflozin rise in renal impairment (AUC ratio 1.20, 1.23, 1.67 [Macha2014f]).
Empagliflozin lowers the renal threshold of glucose (RTG) by the inhibition of SGLT2; glucose above the RTG is excreted with the GFR.
The content of this model has been carefully created in a manual research effort.

body.p: Empagliflozin and EG in the urine, compared with the total radioactivity in the urine.

Fasting plasma glucose (FPG), set by the studies. It shifts the RTG (SGLT2 is induced in type 2 diabetes) and, with the difference of the mean plasma glucose of the day to the FPG (PG_delta), gives the glucose which is filtered.

blockquote.p: 1.0: increased kidney function 1.0: normal kidney function (healthy control) <1.0: decreased kidney function

body.p: Renal function relative to the healthy glomerular filtration rate GFR_base, which is 101 ml/min at 75 kg; a measured creatinine clearance or GFR of X ml/min is the renal function X/101. It scales the filtration (renal excretion, glucose excretion) and the renal glucuronidation (the functional renal mass).
Scaling factor of the UGT activity of the kidney (and the liver, the parameter of the whole-body model replaces both). 1.0: normal activity; <1.0 decreased activity; >1.0 increased activity.

Scaling factor of the basolateral uptake of empagliflozin into the proximal tubule by OAT3: the tubular secretion and the renal glucuronidation. Probenecid, an inhibitor of OAT1/OAT3, lowers the renal clearance of empagliflozin from 32.7 to 15.2 ml/min, the filtration of the unbound fraction [Macha2014]. 1.0: normal activity; <1.0 inhibited.
Empagliflozin is 80-86 % bound to plasma proteins [Chen2015a, Macha2014f], independent of the renal function.

parameter.name: tubular secretion of empagliflozin relative to its filtration

body.p: The renal clearance of empagliflozin is the filtration of its unbound fraction, fu_emp * GFR (14 ml/min), and the tubular secretion by OAT3, EMPSEC_f times the filtration. The renal clearance of 28-39 ml/min [Seman2013, Sarashina2013, Macha2014] is about twice the filtration.
The value of KI__EMPSEC_f is the result of the fit PK_20261019_201013__13ddc, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: renal clearance of EG relative to the GFR

body.p: The renal clearance of the glucuronides is EGEX_f times the GFR; the glucuronides are about 0.2 of empagliflozin in the plasma (17.7 % vs 79.6 % of the radioactivity, AUC 0-12 hr) [Chen2015a], their kinetics are limited by their formation.
The value of KI__EGEX_f is the result of the fit PK_20261019_201013__13ddc, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: rate of the renal glucuronidation of empagliflozin

body.p: First-order rate of the renal glucuronidation relative to the volume of the kidney; the whole-body model sets it from the hepatic rate and the renal fraction of the glucuronidation.

parameter.name: mean plasma glucose of the day minus the fasting plasma glucose

body.p: The glucose which is filtered over the day is the mean plasma glucose of the day, above the fasting plasma glucose by the meals. In healthy subjects the 24-hr mean plasma glucose is 5.6-5.7 mM [Seman2013, Sarashina2013], 0.7 mM above a fasting plasma glucose of 5 mM. Studies which report the 24-hr mean plasma glucose set the difference to the FPG.

EC50 of the reduction of the RTG by plasma empagliflozin (total). The IC50 of empagliflozin for human SGLT2 is 3.1 nM [Grempler2012]; SGLT2 is inhibited from the tubular lumen, where empagliflozin is concentrated by the filtration, the secretion and the reabsorption of water. The urinary glucose excretion of 1 mg is a third of the maximal one [Sarashina2013]; the fit gives about 4 nM total plasma empagliflozin (0.6 nM unbound).
The value of KI__RTG_E50 is the result of the fit PD_20261019_212349__c28ac, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

Increase of the RTG per mM of FPG above the healthy FPG: SGLT2 is induced in type 2 diabetes [Rahmoune2005]. Phenomenological: it gives the urinary glucose excretion of type 2 diabetes (78-102 g with 25-50 mg [Heise2013, Sarashina2014, Macha2014f]) with the constant glucose of the model, which has no fall of the glucose during the treatment.

parameter.name: maximal relative reduction of the RTG

body.p: Maximal reduction of the RTG by SGLT2 inhibition relative to the RTG without inhibition: SGLT1 reabsorbs the glucose which SGLT2 does not.
The value of KI__RTG_max_inhibition is the result of the fit PD_20261019_212349__c28ac, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: splay of the glucose excretion around the RTG

body.p: The thresholds of the nephrons differ, so the glucose excretion rises smoothly around the RTG (splay) instead of at a sharp threshold; the softplus with a width of 1 mM.

parameter.name: mean plasma glucose of the day

assignmentRule.name: mean plasma glucose of the day

body.p: The glucose which is filtered.
FPG dependent RTG without SGLT2 inhibition. SGLT2 is induced in T2DM [Rahmoune2005].
Renal threshold glucose.

The renal threshold for glucose (RTG) is the plasma glucose concentration at which the tubular reabsorption of glucose begins to saturate; glucose is excreted into the urine in proportion to the glucose concentration above this threshold.
Urinary glucose excretion, the cumulative amount of glucose in the urine.
The glucuronidation of the empagliflozin of the renal plasma after the uptake by OAT3; the export of EG is fast.
The filtered glucose above the RTG, the softplus of the difference with the width RTG_splay: the excretion approaches GFR * (pg - RTG) above the RTG and zero below it.
